reviews.title: Frustrating to set
reviews.review_text: Frustrating to set all of the features. Set one feature like the time , when you set the date, the time changes then there's the day of the week. Plus a multitude of settings to be made in order to set the clock up to begin to use it. The charging part was great. No problem there. It is quite, Quite possible that I missed a step but I have given up. I will return it.

reviews.title: Hmmm. kind of fishy...
reviews.review_text: The clock works fine. Don't be mistaken by the reviews on this item. Most of them describe a picture download/display feature which does not come with this clock. Also there is no apparent manufacturer with this item, just a big print on the box that says made in China. This may be a knock off of the real company not sure. But overall I like the clock but I'm seeing better prices on Amazon.
